source.title: Hood of Raging Tempests — Wowhead item comment by Ithereal86
source.author: Ithereal86

quote: Disenchants to either 1-2 Vibrant Shards, 1 Resonant Crystal or 2-3 Chromatic Dusts.
notes: Single Wowhead commenter gives possible disenchant output stack ranges, but no original sample size, per-material hits, completed casts, probability, talent/skill, material zeros, or observed extrema by cast. Comment mentions base blue ilvl 359 and upgraded purple ilvl 385 without specifying which item version each range applies to. REFERENCE ONLY; not measured and not current-retail verified.
